shortDescription: Fast, private file and text transfers across your local network.
description:
Tonarink is an independent Windows app for transferring files, folders, text, and clipboard content directly between nearby devices on your local network. No account or cloud upload is required.

Discover LocalSend-compatible devices automatically, review incoming files before accepting them, or send directly to a saved address. Tonarink also integrates with Windows sharing, File Explorer, notifications, the taskbar, and the system tray.

Web sharing and web receiving let another device use a browser when installing an app is not convenient. Optional PIN protection, checksum verification, favorites, transfer history, and selective receiving give you control over each transfer.

Tonarink is an unofficial implementation of the LocalSend protocol. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the official LocalSend project.
features: Send and receive files, folders, text, and clipboard content over your local network
Review, rename, select, and choose a destination for incoming files
Share or receive through a temporary local web page
Use optional PIN protection and checksum verification
Integrate with Windows Share, File Explorer, notifications, the taskbar, and the system tray
Save favorite devices, manual addresses, and optional receive history
Support English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, and Spanish, and follow the Windows theme
releaseNotes: Tonarink is ready for its first Microsoft Store release, with local file and text transfer, Windows integration, web sharing and receiving, device verification, and configurable privacy controls.
